A '''battle''' occurred at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ketaris/Legends|Ketaris]] in the [[Imperial Skirmishes]], a desperate attempt by the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] and the [[replacement warlord]]s to turn the tide in the Galactic Civil War.
